about-simple-dynamic.subIntro: With over 20 years of industry experience, we are an ISO 9001:2015 certified institute providing direct certifications from leading software providers.
about-simple-dynamic.mainStatement: IBS Academy is the No.1 Tally Institute in India, certified by Tally Education Pvt. Ltd. Our commitment to excellence extends beyond the classroom as we strive to uphold the highest standards of professionalism. We equip students with a deep understanding of key accounting concepts and practices through an industry-relevant syllabus, offering programs like US CPA, CMA, and diplomas in financial accounting. Our mission is to be the gateway to success for aspiring finance professionals.

testimonials.name: Anjali S.
testimonials.text: The US CPA program at IBS Academy was transformative. The expert support and industry-relevant curriculum gave me the confidence to pass all four papers and launch my international career.

testimonials.name: Rahul K.
testimonials.text: As a Diploma in Financial Accounting & Taxation graduate, I secured a placement immediately. The practical, hands-on approach truly prepares you for the real world of finance.

testimonials.name: Priya M.
testimonials.text: Choosing IBS Academy for my CMA certification was the best decision. The institute's commitment to excellence and direct certification pathways opened doors I never thought possible.

testimonials.name: Suresh N.
testimonials.text: The 100% placement assistance is real. With the skills from the Professional Accounting certification, I received multiple job offers even before completing the course.

testimonials.name: Meera P.
testimonials.text: The faculty's deep expertise and the institute's partnership with Tally Education provided an unmatched learning experience, making complex accounting concepts clear and manageable.

testimonials.name: Arun V.
testimonials.text: IBS Academy's 20+ years of experience shows in their structured programs. The gateway to success they provide through financial mastery is genuine and impactful.
